forward_patch:
--- original
+++ modified
@@ -0,0 +1,67 @@
+---
+assignees:
+- claude-code
+position_column: todo
+position_ordinal: '8380'
+title: Move acp-agent to Sources and give it an ArgumentParser subcommand tree
+---
+## What
+
+cli-plan.md §5.1 and §5.3. This is the structural change that every
+other CLI task builds on.
+
+1. Move `Examples/acp-agent/` to `Sources/acp-agent/`. It stops being an
+   example, because it becomes the product. `Examples/acp-print/` does
+   NOT move, and it does not change.
+2. In `Package.swift`, declare
+   `.package(url: "https://github.com/apple/swift-argument-parser.git", from: "1.8.0")`.
+   The floor matches Extras, and the package is already in
+   `Package.resolved`, so no new checkout happens. Add `ArgumentParser`
+   to the `acp-agent` target, and change its `path` to
+   `Sources/acp-agent`. The executable product keeps the name
+   `acp-agent`, so `swift run acp-agent` and the tier-3 spawn still name
+   one binary.
+3. Replace the top-level `main.swift` with an `@main` `ParsableCommand`
+   tree in `Sources/acp-agent/`:
+   - `AcpAgentCommand` — the root, with `defaultSubcommand: Run.self`,
+     `version:` set, and the subcommands `Run`, `Acp`, `Config`,
+     `Instructions`, `Doctor`.
+   - `Run` takes one optional positional `prompt` and the options of
+     §5.4. Its body is a stub that exits 1 in this task.
+   - `Acp`, `Config`, `Instructions` and `Doctor` are stubs that exit 1.
+     Later tasks fill them.
+
+`run` is the default subcommand, so `acp-agent "write a haiku"` reaches
+`Run`. A prompt that is exactly a subcommand name selects that mode
+instead, and `acp-agent run doctor` is the explicit escape.
+
+- [ ] Move the directory, and update `Package.swift`
+- [ ] Declare `swift-argument-parser` and link it
+- [ ] Write the command tree with the stub bodies
+- [ ] `--help` and `--version` to stdout, exit 0
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+
+- [ ] `swift build` succeeds, and `swift run acp-agent --help` prints
+      the usage to stdout and exits 0.
+- [ ] `swift run acp-agent --version` prints a version and exits 0.
+- [ ] `Package.resolved` gains no new package: `swift-argument-parser`
+      was already there through Extras.
+- [ ] `Examples/acp-print/main.swift` is byte-identical to its state
+      before this task.
+- [ ] The existing gated tier-3 `StdioContractTests` still finds and
+      spawns the `acp-agent` binary.
+
+## Tests
+
+- [ ] `Tests/FoundationModelsACPAgentTests/CLIParsingTests.swift`: parse
+      each form of §5.3 with `AcpAgentCommand.parseAsRoot(_:)` and
+      assert the selected command type — bare prompt gives `Run`, `acp`
+      gives `Acp`, `run doctor` gives `Run` with `prompt == "doctor"`.
+- [ ] A usage error (an unknown option) exits 2 and writes to stderr,
+      with stdout empty.
+- [ ] `swift test --filter CLIParsingTests` passes.
+- [ ] `swift build` passes with no warning.
+
+## Workflow
+- Use `/tdd` — write failing tests first, then implement to make them pass.
\ No newline at end of file
